clf-avc-091.text: A company wants application capacity to grow and shrink automatically according to workload demand so it avoids both overload and long periods of idle compute. Which AWS capability best implements this elasticity for EC2 fleets?
clf-avc-091.explanation: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling adjusts the number of EC2 instances according to scaling policies and demand, helping maintain performance while reducing unnecessary idle capacity.
clf-avc-091.hint: Think of the service that changes fleet size automatically.
optionRationales: EC2 Auto Scaling provides dynamic fleet capacity.
